desc: Implement a Binary Indexed Tree (BIT) that supports point updates and prefix sum queries, and also supports finding the k-th one (i.e., the k-th empty slot) using binary lifting.
Read the input N and the array P.
Initialize a BIT of size N with all 1s (each position is initially an empty slot).
Process from i = N down to 1: use the BIT to find the P_i-th empty slot, assign A[index] = i, and update the BIT to mark that slot as filled (set to 0).
